arg.name: platform
arg.description: pc | orin

arg.name: vehicle
arg.description: calibration folder in fusion_vehicles (vehicles/<vehicle>/)

arg.name: rectify_balance
arg.description: 0 = crop to valid pixels, 1 = keep full fisheye view

arg.name: bag
arg.description: rosbag2 directory to play, no trailing slash (empty = live sensors)

arg.name: bag_read_ahead
arg.description: messages ros2 bag play buffers ahead (default 1000); raise if it reports 'Message queue starved'

arg.name: detections_json
arg.description: PC json_replay: precompute_detections output

arg.name: detector_model_type
arg.description: yolox (18 classes) | yolov8 (COCO; set the classes in object_detection_*.yaml)

arg.name: camera
arg.description: camera detector (object_detection); false: radar only

arg.name: lane
arg.description: lane / road segmentation in object_detection + boundaries in sensor_fusion

arg.name: lane_backend
arg.description: auto (pc: replay, orin: tensorrt) | onnxruntime

arg.name: lane_model_path
arg.description: Orin: TensorRT engine; PC onnxruntime backend: .onnx

arg.name: lane_replay_dir
arg.description: PC replay: precomputed masks

arg.name: model_path
arg.description: Orin: TensorRT engine; PC onnxruntime backend: .onnx

arg.name: detector_backend
arg.description: auto (pc: json_replay, orin: tensorrt) | onnxruntime | opencv_dnn

arg.name: radar_height
arg.description: radar height above ground [m] (from calibration measurements)

arg.name: radar_mount_x
arg.description: radar origin x in base_link [m], temporary front-bumper default used when radar TF is absent

arg.name: radar_mount_y
arg.description: radar origin y in base_link [m], used when radar TF is absent

arg.name: radar_mount_yaw
arg.description: radar yaw in base_link [rad], used when radar TF is absent

arg.name: publish_radar_tf
arg.description: publish configurable base_link -> umrr static TF (enable for bags that did not record it)

arg.name: odom_topic
arg.description: nav_msgs/Odometry for ego motion (Gazebo: /ackermann_steering_controller/odometry)

arg.name: ego_speed_source
arg.description: radar_doppler | odom (Gazebo radar_sim has no Doppler: odom)

arg.name: use_doppler
arg.description: use radar Doppler in tracking (false for Gazebo radar_sim, radial_speed is always 0)

arg.name: output_trigger
arg.description: camera: publish per detector frame (radar only after output.camera_timeout without camera) | all: also every radar scan

arg.name: output_frame
arg.description: Cartesian frame for /sensor_fusion/objects; requires TF from the radar/base at each stamp

arg.name: base_frame
arg.description: vehicle frame used with configured radar mount when radar TF is absent

arg.name: reorder_delay
arg.description: sensor-cycle holdback [s], useful for bag TF arriving just after sensor messages

arg.name: output_tf_tolerance
arg.description: max age [s] of the newest TF when it does not cover the output stamp (gap bridged with ego motion)

arg.name: max_range
arg.description: final object list range [m]

arg.name: radar_fov
arg.description: radar half field of view [rad] (filter + RViz sector)

arg.name: radar_range
arg.description: radar max range [m] (filter + RViz sector)

arg.name: relative_prediction_horizon
arg.description: future fused-object prediction horizon [s]

arg.name: relative_radial_speed_threshold
arg.description: closing-speed deadband [m/s]

arg.name: relative_min_ego_speed
arg.description: minimum ego speed for same_direction [m/s]

arg.name: relative_min_object_speed
arg.description: minimum object speed for same_direction [m/s]

arg.name: relative_same_direction_max_angle
arg.description: maximum ego/object heading difference [deg]

arg.name: radar_tracker
arg.description: ekf: the EKF radar tracker (radar_tracker node) | imm: sensor_fusion's clustering + IMM tracker

arg.name: visualization
arg.description: fusion_visualization markers node (false = detection + fusion only)

arg.name: overlay
arg.description: draw the fused boxes on the image (/fusion_visualization/overlay)

arg.name: show_window
arg.description: also show the overlay in an OpenCV window (needs overlay:=true)

arg.name: overlay_rate
arg.description: overlay image rate [Hz], 0 = every camera frame

arg.name: overlay_scale
arg.description: overlay image scale (0.5 = 4x smaller)

arg.name: record
arg.description: record fusion + detection + visualization outputs

arg.name: record_path
arg.description: output bag directory (must not exist)

node.name: radar_mount_tf
node.args: --x $(var radar_mount_x) --y $(var radar_mount_y) --z $(var radar_height) --roll 0 --pitch 0 --yaw $(var radar_mount_yaw) --frame-id $(var base_frame) --child-frame-id umrr

executable.cmd: ros2 bag play $(var bag) --clock --rate $(var bag_rate) --read-ahead-queue-size $(var bag_read_ahead) --topics /smart_radar/can_targets_0 /odom /steering_angle /camera/image_raw /tf /tf_static /map /map_metadata /velodyne_points
